full_name: Susanna Blumenthal | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Susanna Blumenthal, an assistant professor at the University of Michigan Law School, researches and teaches in the field of American legal history, exploring its cultural foundations. Her work is particularly concerned with conceptions of human nature embedded in legal thought and practice.
